title: Delete or fix the tautological empty-list StreakReducer assertion in epic_27_story_05_bulk_mark_prior_test.dart
why: The comment above (lines 166-176) claims this 'pins the reducer directly against the empty event log' and replays 'the events attributable to the batch', but the code passes a literal `const <StreakEvent>[]`, never the `streakRows` queried two blocks earlier — so `reducerState.currentStreak == 0` is true by construction for any run, proving nothing about bulkMarkComplete. No coverage gap results (the preceding `streakRows, isEmpty` assertion at line 154-164 already correctly covers the real invariant against the DB), but the block misleads a reader into thinking the reducer was exercised against real data.
recommendation: Either delete the redundant block, or map the already-queried `streakRows` into StreakEvents and reduce those instead of a hardcoded empty list.
acceptance_criteria: The reducer assertion consumes the DB-queried rows, or the redundant block is removed.
